transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?
I guess… I’m here because I’m having trouble stopping myself once I start eating. It’s like my hands keep reaching for more, even when I’m telling myself, “Tom, stop this.” It scares me.
Do you ever eat a large amount of food in a short period of time, like within an hour or two?
Yes… especially when I’m alone in the afternoons. I can go through bread, peanut butter, cookies, whatever leftovers are there… even ice cream. It’s a lot, before I really notice what I’ve done.
Do you feel guilty after these episodes of eating a large amount of food?
I… I don’t know. I don’t really like thinking about it after. I just try to put it out of my mind.
Do you ever try to get rid of the extra calories after one of these eating episodes?
Sometimes… yes. I don’t like saying it, but I’ve gone to the bathroom after and made myself throw up. And… I’ve used laxatives too, because I get scared it’s all just going to stay in me.
How often do these episodes of eating a large amount of food happen?
It’s… pretty much every week. My food logs show it’s been going on for months now—usually at least one afternoon where I lose control like that.
During these episodes of eating a large amount of food, do you feel like you're unable to stop or control what you're eating?
Yes… that’s the part that scares me. Once I start, it’s like my hands just keep going for more, even while I’m telling myself, “Tom, stop.”
Do you feel guilty or bad about yourself after these episodes of eating a large amount of food?
I… I don’t really know how to talk about that. I just feel pretty lousy afterward, I guess. Like I’d rather not think about it.
Do you always try to get rid of the extra calories after one of these eating episodes?
Not always… but, yes, sometimes I do. I’ll go to the bathroom and make myself throw up. And… I’ve taken laxatives too, because I get scared the food’s just going to stay in me.
How often do you make yourself throw up or use laxatives after eating?
It’s… hard to say exactly. It happens after some of those times when I eat too much. I’ll make myself throw up, or sometimes use laxatives… not every time, but enough that it worries me.
How often do you make yourself throw up or use laxatives in a month?

I… I don’t keep a real count. But in a month, it’s more than a few times. There are times after I eat too much when I go to the bathroom and make myself throw up, and sometimes I take laxatives too… because I get scared the food will stay in me.
Do you make yourself throw up or use laxatives after almost every time you eat a large amount of food?
Not almost every time, no… but there are times after I eat too much when I go and make myself bring it back up. And I’ve used laxatives too, when I get scared it’s going to stay in me.
Do you make yourself throw up or use laxatives at least once a week?

Yes… at least once a week, I think. My logs show that most weeks there’s been at least one afternoon where I lose control with eating and then try to make up for it somehow… throwing up or laxatives, sometimes not eating after, or just pushing myself around the house. It’s been going on for months.
Do you make yourself throw up or use laxatives after most of the times you eat a large amount of food?
I guess… yes, a lot of the time when I eat too much, I end up going to the bathroom and making myself bring it back up. Sometimes I take laxatives too, because I get scared it’ll just stay in me.
Do you make yourself throw up or use laxatives after almost all of the times you eat a large amount of food?

Almost all… I don’t know. A lot of the times, yes. If I feel like I ate too much, I’ll go to the bathroom and make myself throw up. Sometimes I’ve taken laxatives too, because I get scared it’s just going to stay in me.
Do you make yourself throw up or use laxatives after every single time you eat a large amount of food?
Not every single time… but there are times after I eat too much when I go to the bathroom and make myself bring it back up. And… I’ve taken laxatives too, when I’m scared the food will stay in me.
Do you make yourself throw up or use laxatives after almost every episode of eating a large amount of food?

Pretty close to that, I guess. If I eat what feels like too much, I usually end up in the bathroom trying to bring it back up. And sometimes I’ve used laxatives… I just get scared it’s going to stay in me.
